question: What destructive power belongs to the practitioner when anger arises?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry.
The power to destroy is stated.
The entire triple world with moving and unmoving beings is the object.
inference: When angry, the practitioner can destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
